raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Since 2026-01-17 the v2 collector emits txn_ts in UTC while legacy emits America/Chicago local time, and silver_transactions casts both as if they were the same. As a result, v2 evening transactions from Jan 18 local (CST, UTC-6) land on 2026-01-19 00:00-06:00, and all v2 timestamps are shifted 6 hours late. The fix converts v2 rows to Chicago local time; the 6-hour offset is correct here because all data falls in January (no DST).", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
